No one is born perfect… 

In 2018, Erste Group put out a Christmas ad that focused more on empathy and inclusion than on banking. It tells the story of a little hedgehog who feels left out because his sharp spines make other animals scared to get close—kind of highlighting loneliness and feeling excluded.

As the story goes on, the other animals eventually accept him, showing that a bit of understanding and kindness can go a long way. The ad was made with Jung von Matt DONAU and ended up being shared all over Europe, helping build Erste’s reputation for heartfelt holiday ads.

🎥: Erste Group
